CONFIRMATION — Final candidate stands as submitted.

Deliverable recap (unchanged, ready for submission):
- QUESTION: demographic disparities in median 1985 wealth among ever-incarcerated individuals.
- ANSWER (natural-language hypothesis, descriptive): among individuals jailed 1985–1994, median composite_wealth_1985 was much lower than among the never-incarcerated (overall $720, n=289, vs $3,600, n=11,724; ~5-fold gap), with a demographic gradient within the incarcerated group: White median ≈ $2,200 (n=69) vs Black ≈ $320 (n=159) vs Hispanic ≈ $0 (n=61); the group is overwhelmingly male (252/289, male median $1,000); every race/sex incumbent stratum has lower median wealth than its never-incarcerated counterpart; low Black/Hispanic medians partly reflect very high zero-wealth shares (43–48%); female cells (n=9–16) too small to interpret; temporal caveat (1985 wealth predates 1985–1994 jail spells) noted, so the claim is descriptive, not causal.
- PAYLOAD: hypothesis populated; workflow describes the executed pipeline; executed_analysis=true.
- ARTIFACTS (local): analysis/nls_incarceration_analysis.py (executed, exit 0), analysis/median_wealth_by_group.csv, analysis/results_summary.txt.
- EVIDENCE INCLUDED IN PRIOR HANDOFF: exact medians, n per cell, bootstrap 95% CIs, sensitivity medians (exclude negatives/zeros, trimmed), and non-parametric test p-values (KW p=0.070; MW Black-vs-White p=0.047, Hispanic-vs-White p=0.041).

No further changes are required; the final candidate stands as approved.

payload.workflow: Loaded data; normalized hispanic typo; computed median composite_wealth_1985 by race/sex/race-x-sex within ever_jailed==1 (primary) and 0 (context); sensitivity variants (exclude negatives, exclude zeros, top-1% trimmed); bootstrap 95% CIs for jailed race medians; descriptive non-parametric tests (KW + pairwise MW + jailed-vs-never per race). Final hypothesis descriptive, with temporal caveat.
